capabilities_done: A white balance, raw form (STU-RAW-110): DngRaw::recipe_for_white / recipe_for_white_point(colour, xyz_d50_to_profile, profile, baseline, kelvin, tint): kelvin 2000..25000 (Kim Planckian locus), tint -150..150 (uv offset 1/3000 per count along the locus normal, + = greener illuminant = magenta correction); the target white's xy replaces AsShotNeutral in the DNG colour solution (CM/FM interpolation, Bradford as before); recipe carries WbMode::Temperature + Adjustments.absolute_white_balance; mode and request must agree (Temperature without request = unsupported_white_balance, AsShot with a request = invalid_adjustment); kelvin above 25000 is refused (spec soft maximum 50000 NOT reached)

A point colour (colour.rs, STU-RAW-115): up to 16 points {source encoded RGB, hue shift, saturation, luminance, 3 range sliders}; weight = product of smooth hue / saturation / value falloffs; gated by enable_colour_adjustments
A grayscale mix: convert flag + 8 hue-band weights (partition-of-unity weights, scaled by saturation so greys are fixed points); gated by enable_grayscale_mix (no longer refused)

A colour grading (STU-RAW-116): shadows / midtones / highlights / global wheels (hue 0..360, saturation 0..100, luminance -100..100), blending 0..100, balance -100..100; region weights are a partition of unity; gated by enable_colour_adjustments
A/B/C: Adjustments version 1.1 (ADJUST_VERSION), 1.0 (ADJUST_MIN_VERSION) still read; all new families are identity by default and validated even while their group is off
B texture: Gaussian detail layer (sigma clamp(0.002*short side,1,8) px), gain 0.6

B dehaze: dark channel prior (He, Sun, Tang 2009): per-pixel channel minimum, min filter radius max(2, round(0.008*short side)), atmospheric light = brightest pixel among the top 0.1 percent of the dark channel (floor 0.05), transmission 1-0.95*strength*darkchannel(I/A) smoothed by a 3-pass box blur (NOT soft matting or a guided filter), floor 0.1, J=(I-A)/t+A; negative = uniform haze with transmission 1-0.5*|amount|

B sharpening: unsharp mask on encoded luma with Gaussian sigma = radius (0.5..3.0), amount 0..150, detail 0..100 compresses halos (d/(1+(1-detail)*8|d|)), edge masking 0..100 = smoothstep of blurred-luma gradient over masking*0.08
B noise reduction: separable bilateral approximation guided by encoded luma; luminance (sigma_s 0.8+1.7l, sigma_r 0.01+0.06l) and colour (channel-minus-luma planes, sigma_s 1+4c, sigma_r 0.05+0.1c)

B order inside enable_detail: noise reduction, dehaze, texture, clarity (slice 1 of CONTROLS), sharpening; whole-frame, develop_to_image only: the tile API refuses each as unsupported_contribution:<noise_reduction|dehaze|texture|sharpening>_whole_frame

C range masks: MaskSource::LuminanceRange {lo, hi, feather} (encoded weighted luma window) and MaskSource::ColourRange {1..16 encoded samples, breadth} (radius 0.02+0.6*breadth, full inside half of it); evaluated on the image as it was before any correction ran; combine with gradient and brush masks through the existing add/subtract/inverted/value algebra; brush rasteriser unchanged (no pigment edge)
